verdict.rationale: Intercom publishes an official TypeScript SDK (intercom/intercom-node) for the Intercom APIs. It includes Fin-relevant AI content calls such as `aiContent.createContentImportSource` and paginated iterators, so developers can build against an official library. However, only one language SDK is evidenced, and nothing shows the SDK covers the Fin Agent API orchestration endpoints, which are Preview-only. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other languages, SDK coverage of the Fin Agent API (Ask Fin, procedures, escalation) and the Fin API platform answer/retrieval APIs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Intercom TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Intercom APIs from TypeScript.
List endpoints are paginated. The SDK provides an iterator so that you can simply loop over the items
